## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintainer-visible change.

## Rationale

Explain why the change is needed and identify any important design or integrity decision.

## Validation

List the exact commands or artifacts used to validate the change, including relevant results and any
required gate that was not run.

## Limitations and follow-up

State material limitations or follow-up work. Write `None` when there are none.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests cover the behaviour at the layer required by the claim.
- [ ] Documentation, migrations, manifests, and failure semantics are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Public claims match current evidence and state their limitations.
- [ ] The diff contains no secrets, temporary planning material, fetched datasets, or temporary
      artifacts.
